intro.fr: Very Very Valet se joue en multiworld Archipelago depuis 2026.
intro.en: Very Very Valet has been playable in an Archipelago multiworld since 2026.

text.fr: Toyful sort Very Very Valet en 2021.
text.en: Toyful releases Very Very Valet in 2021.

text.fr: xMcacutt publie le 11 mars 2026 la version 1.0.0 de l'APWorld.
text.en: xMcacutt releases version 1.0.0 of the APWorld on March 11, 2026.

text.fr: La version 1.0.1 sort le 29 mars 2026 ; c'est la plus récente au 23 octobre 2026 (2 versions publiées).
text.en: Version 1.0.1 is released on March 29, 2026; it is the latest as of October 23, 2026 (2 versions released).
